01 다음 대화를 나오는 순서대로 누르시오.
시작 문장은 이미 나와 있습니다. 그다음부터 누르세요.
시작: There are many games here. Why don't we play a game?

orderChunks.text: Sure! Oh, look over there. Why are people throwing sticks into a pot?
They are playing tuho.
What is tuho?
It's a traditional Korean game. You throw sticks into a pot. Then you get points.
It looks fun! Let's play it.

That sounds great!

orderChunks.text: Why are those people throwing sticks in the air?
They are playing yunnori.
What is yunnori?
It is a traditional Korean board game.
I want to try it, but I don't know the rules.
It's simple. You just throw four sticks, and they decide your moves. Why don't we play the game?
Okay. That sounds fun!

orderChunks.text: Hey, Tate. That man is wearing a unique hat. What is it?
It is a gat. It's a traditional Korean hat.
I see. It looks nice.
Yes. In the past, men wore a gat when they went out.
Right. And it's light and cool. Why don't we try on a gat?
Sure. Where can we do that?
There's a hanbok shop over there. Let's go.

orderChunks.text: Hi, Yejun! How was your trip to Andong?
It was great! I watched a Hahoe talchum performance.
What is Hahoe talchum?
It is a traditional Korean dance drama. The dancers wear masks and dance to exciting music.
Sounds interesting! What else did you do?
I ate jjimdak. Andong is famous for jjimdak! It is a chicken dish, and it's delicious.
Wow, I really want to try it.
Why don't we eat jjimdak together sometime?
I'd love to!

orderChunks.text: Mom, what are you reading?
I'm reading a book about beautiful places in Korea.
Sounds interesting.
Jungnogwon looks so amazing!
What is Jungnogwon?
It is a bamboo forest in Damyang.
It looks wonderful! Why don't we go there this Sunday?
That's a fantastic idea.
